meta.title: Kiln Yoga | Small yoga classes in Peckham, London
meta.description: A warm yoga studio above a bakery in Peckham. Only 14 mats. Slow flow, yin, a 4 week beginners course and pregnancy yoga on Saturdays.

rationale: A kiln is orange, hot and handmade, so the page is a screen-printed poster in terracotta orange with deep oxblood type and a cream band. It feels like the warm wooden room above the bakery and nothing like a grey gym or a glossy yoga brand. The hand-drawn floor plan with exactly 14 mats, the stamp and the slow marquee carry the 'small classes' promise, while a numbered index and a plain letter from Mei keep the page organised and personal.

props.headline: Fourteen mats. One warm room.
props.sub: Small yoga classes above a bakery in Peckham. Wooden floor, big windows, and the smell of bread in the mornings.

props.label: Classes
props.title: What we teach
props.intro: Mei teaches most classes, with two other teachers. Book a single class or buy a class pass.

items.name: Slow flow
items.description: Moving with the breath at an unhurried pace. Long enough in each shape to actually feel it. Good for most bodies.

items.name: Yin
items.description: Floor-based, quiet and long-held. Bring your tired self, leave with a looser back and a calmer head.

items.name: Beginners course
items.description: Four weeks with the same small group, so you learn the basics without hurrying or feeling watched.

items.name: Pregnancy yoga
items.description: Saturday mornings. Gentle movement, breathing and rest, with other people who are also expecting.

props.caption: The room, drawn to scale-ish. Fourteen mats, big windows along the top, and the door at the back.

props.label: From Mei
paragraphs: Kiln is a small studio above a bakery in Peckham. I kept it to fourteen mats on purpose, so that the teacher can see everyone and nobody gets lost at the back.
I teach most of the classes myself, with two other teachers I trust. We go slowly. The room is warm, the floor is wood, and on early mornings the whole place smells of bread.
If you have never done yoga, start with the four week beginners course. If you are pregnant, come on a Saturday morning. Either way, you are welcome here.
props.name: Mei

items.q: Can I book a single class?
items.a: Yes. You can book one class at a time, or buy a class pass if you plan to come often.

items.q: I have never done yoga. Where do I start?
items.a: Take the four week beginners course. It is a small group that stays the same, so you can learn at your own speed.
So the classes stay small and the teacher can see and help everyone in the room.
Comfortable clothes. Tell us if you need to borrow a mat when you book.

props.title: Come upstairs
props.address: Above the bakery, Rye Lane area, Peckham, London SE15
props.directions: Look for the bakery on the street, and the door to the stairs next to it. Walk up to the first floor.
